body.prompt: Rewrite the sentence in the passive voice, beginning with 'The new library': They built the new library in 2019.
acceptable: The new library was built in the year 2019.

_provenance.cefr_reasoning: The item requires transforming a simple past active sentence into the passive voice ('was built'). While the passive voice is often associated with B2, a basic past simple passive with regular vocabulary and a single clause is commonly taught and mastered at B1. The vocabulary ('built', 'library') is everyday and the transformation involves only one grammatical operation, making it appropriate for B1 rather than B2.

blind_solve_answer.answer: The new library was built in 2019.

explanation.explanation_en: To form the passive voice, use the verb 'to be' in the same tense as the active verb (past simple: 'was') plus the past participle ('built'). The object of the active sentence ('the new library') becomes the subject, and the agent ('they') is omitted because it is unimportant or unknown.
explanation.explanation_vi: Để chuyển sang câu bị động, dùng động từ 'to be' ở cùng thì với câu chủ động (quá khứ đơn: 'was') cộng với quá khứ phân từ ('built'). Tân ngữ của câu chủ động ('the new library') trở thành chủ ngữ, và tác nhân ('they') được lược bỏ vì không quan trọng hoặc không rõ.

body.correct_answer: The new library was built in 2019.

body.prompt: The new library ___ last month, and it is now open to the public.

_provenance.cefr_reasoning: The item tests past simple passive ('was built') in a simple, clear sentence with everyday vocabulary. While passive voice is often labeled B2 in descriptors, a single basic passive form with past simple in a familiar context is commonly taught at B1; distractors are straightforward, making the item accessible at B1 rather than B2.

explanation.explanation_en: The passive voice 'was built' is used because the library did not perform the action; it received the action. The past simple passive (was/were + past participle) is correct for a completed action in the past.
explanation.explanation_vi: Câu bị động 'was built' được dùng vì thư viện không tự thực hiện hành động mà là đối tượng nhận hành động. Thì quá khứ đơn bị động (was/were + phân từ quá khứ) phù hợp với hành động đã hoàn thành trong quá khứ.

explanation.explanation_en: The passive voice is used because the library receives the action. The past passive 'was designed' is correct: was/were + past participle, since the action happened 'last year'.
explanation.explanation_vi: Câu bị động được dùng vì thư viện là đối tượng nhận hành động. 'Was designed' là dạng bị động quá khứ đúng (was/were + quá khứ phân từ) vì hành động xảy ra 'last year'.

body.prompt: My car ___ yet, so I am taking the bus today.

_provenance.cefr_reasoning: The item tests past simple passive voice with simple, familiar vocabulary ('library', 'architect', 'last year'). While passive voice is often tagged B2, a single-clause passive with regular past simple form and high-frequency vocabulary is accessible to B1 learners and commonly taught at B1 level. Distractors are straightforward tense/voice contrasts.

explanation.explanation_en: The car receives the action, so we need the passive. 'Yet' points to the present perfect, so the form is has/have + been + past participle: 'hasn't been repaired'.
explanation.explanation_vi: Chiếc xe là đối tượng nhận hành động nên cần câu bị động. 'Yet' là dấu hiệu của hiện tại hoàn thành, nên dùng has/have + been + quá khứ phân từ: 'hasn't been repaired'.

examples.note: Past simple passive: 'was built'. The doer (builders) is unknown or unimportant, so it is omitted.
examples.text: The new hospital was built last year.

examples.note: Present simple passive: 'is spoken'. Focuses on the fact, not on who speaks it.
examples.text: English is spoken in many countries around the world.

examples.note: Passive with a modal verb: 'must be submitted'. Common in formal instructions.
examples.text: The report must be submitted by Friday.

body.objective: Understand the formation and core uses of the passive voice across common tenses, and transform active sentences into passive ones accurately.

explanation.en: The passive voice is used when the focus is on the action or the receiver of the action rather than the doer. It is formed with the verb 'to be' (in the appropriate tense) + the past participle of the main verb. For example: present simple 'is/are made', past simple 'was/were built', present perfect 'has/have been written', future 'will be sent', and with modals 'can/must be done'. Use the passive when: (1) the doer is unknown, obvious, or unimportant ('My bike was stolen'); (2) you want to emphasize the result or object ('The bridge was designed by a famous architect'); (3) in formal, scientific, or news writing ('The experiment was conducted in 2020'). If you mention the doer, use 'by' ('The novel was written by Hemingway'). Only transitive verbs (verbs that take an object) can be made passive.
explanation.vi: Câu bị động (passive voice) được dùng khi ta muốn nhấn mạnh vào hành động hoặc người/vật chịu tác động, thay vì người thực hiện hành động. Công thức chung: BE (chia theo thì) + QUÁ KHỨ PHÂN TỪ (V3/V-ed). Ví dụ theo thì: hiện tại đơn 'is/are made', quá khứ đơn 'was/were built', hiện tại hoàn thành 'has/have been written', tương lai 'will be sent', với động từ khuyết thiếu 'can/must be done'. Dùng câu bị động khi: (1) không biết hoặc không cần nói rõ ai thực hiện ('My bike was stolen' – xe đạp của tôi bị đánh cắp); (2) muốn nhấn mạnh kết quả hoặc đối tượng ('The bridge was designed by a famous architect'); (3) trong văn viết trang trọng, khoa học, báo chí ('The experiment was conducted in 2020'). Nếu muốn nêu rõ người thực hiện, dùng 'by' ('The novel was written by Hemingway'). Lưu ý: chỉ động từ có tân ngữ (ngoại động từ) mới lập được câu bị động. Người học Việt Nam thường quên chia 'be' đúng thì hoặc dùng nhầm động từ nguyên mẫu thay vì V3.

common_mistakes.why: The passive requires the past participle (V3), not the past simple form. 'Wrote' is past simple; the correct past participle of 'write' is 'written'.
common_mistakes.right: The letter was written by my brother.
common_mistakes.wrong: The letter was wrote by my brother.

common_mistakes.why: The passive needs the verb 'to be' in the correct tense before the past participle. Omitting 'was' makes the sentence grammatically incomplete.
